comment: Shared pin for the transcript text normalization: the Rust `normalize_transcript_text` (src-tauri/src/database/repositories/transcript.rs, authoritative) and the TypeScript `normalizeTranscriptText` (src/lib/transcript-format.ts, the optimistic mirror) must agree on every case here. Whitespace means Unicode White_Space (Rust char::is_whitespace): U+0085 NEL splits words, U+FEFF BOM does not — JS `\s` diverges from both, so the mirror uses `\p{White_Space}`.

cases.description: newlines collapse to a single space
tabs collapse to a single space
next line (U+0085 NEL, White_Space in Rust) splits
zero-width space (U+200B, not White_Space) is kept
word joiner (U+2060, not White_Space) is kept
BOM (U+FEFF, not White_Space in Rust) is kept
